We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Defendant Lü 3 (吕3某) in 2015 July, without ability to repay, fabricated reasons (lack of guarantee money for contracted project) and twice defrauded victim Xie 4 (谢某4) total 42,000 RMB. Evidence includes victim statements, witnesses, bank transaction details, loan documents, defendant's statements. Prosecutor says behavior violates Criminal Law, constitutes ... (unspecified) and is a repeat offender, also other crimes pending, request multiple punishments. Defendant claims not fraud but borrowing money, used for paying workers.

Thus the crime is likely "诈骗" (fraud) because he fabricated reasons to obtain money, no intention to repay, used for other purposes. The amount 42,000 is relatively large, qualifies as fraud. Also possibly "借款诈骗" but just "诈骗". Could also be "非法吸收公众存款"? No, it's a private loan. So "诈骗". Also maybe "数罪并罚" but we only list crimes. So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.

Check examples: For similar scenario (credit card fraud) they used "信用卡诈骗". For loan fraud they used "诈骗". So final answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
